Descriptions

Add natural elegance and functionality to your living room with our rattan sideboard set. This set consists of a rattan chest of drawers and a shoe cabinet, both in an appealing walnut colour. The rattan chest of drawers has three doors that provide practical storage space, while the shoe cabinet is equipped with two sliding doors to keep your shoes neat and easily accessible. The high-quality rattan processing combined with the warm walnut colour creates a harmonious and inviting atmosphere in your living space. This furniture set is not only functional, but also a decorative highlight that will stylishly complement your interior. Key features NATURAL MATERIALS: High-quality rattan and elegant walnut finish. Combined design: Three-door rattan chest of drawers and shoe cabinet with two sliding doors. Multifunctional storage: provides space for books, decoration and shoes. Practical sliding doors: The shoe cabinet has two sliding doors for easy access. Stylish Dresser: The rattan chest of drawers features three doors for versatile storage. Warm walnut colour: gives your living area a cosy and pleasant atmosphere. Experience the perfect combination of fashion and function with our rattan sideboard set, which is both practical and decorative for your living room.
